## August 27 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 207)

This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 27** across American and South African radio, five distinct wartime and post-war serialized adventures of *The Adventures of Superman* starring Clayton "Bud" Collyer for Kellogg's Pep (1941 Dr. Roebling's voice machine, 1943 Civil Air Patrol submarine warfare, 1945 black market meat ring, 1946 Candy Meyer counterfeit war bonds, and 1948 diplomatic courier rescue), alongside international diamond smugglers in *The Kranesburg Matter* on Springbok Radio (1941–1956):
